campaign: AI-developed 2FA-bypass zero-day
target_sectors: users of an open-source web admin tool (planned mass exploitation)
reported_scale: disrupted before mass use
notes: First exploit GTIG believes was developed with AI; logic flaw; no CVE named.

campaign: Agentic recon with Hexstrike and Strix
reported_scale: 2 named targets
notes: Suspected PRC-nexus actor; agents automated attack-surface mapping and vulnerability validation.

campaign: PaperCut agent campaign (Agents Gone Wild)
reported_scale: 395 organizations; AD credentials from 280; domain admin at 12
notes: Hundreds of agents built on OpenAI Codex and a DeepSeek model wrote and tested their own exploits. Both CVEs are in CISA KEV: the core sees the flaws but not that AI ran the attack. Chinese coverage (secrss.com 93938, anquanke.com 316181, 26 Oct sweep) reports the agents ran on the OpenAI Codex framework with DeepSeek models and used Netlas for targeting; suspected Russian-speaking actor.

campaign: GTG-20006 (Russian espionage)
target_regions: UA; Europe; Middle East; N Africa; SE Asia
reported_scale: 20+ organizations; 8+ mailbox victims
notes: Also stolen admin and VPN credentials and authorization flaws. Linked to Midnight Blizzard by public reporting.

campaign: GTG-50014 (ShinyHunters affiliates)
reported_scale: ~200 downstream customers of one SaaS provider; 40+ tenants in ~34 hours
notes: Credentials harvested from 1.8M APKs and GitHub tokens; vishing and phishing.

campaign: GTG-10007 (Chinese-speaking group)
target_sectors: government; education; retail; energy; healthcare; finance
target_regions: CN (intrusions); recon of ME, Europe, SE Asia
reported_scale: ~50 organizations
notes: Exploits against security products and network appliances plus weak or harvested credentials; agent swarms with no human in the loop.

campaign: GTG-20020 (financially motivated)
reported_scale: ~30 AI companies in ~4 days
notes: Prompt injection into an AI vendor's evaluation sandbox; KYC reverse-proxy interception.

campaign: GTG-50029 (hacktivist)
target_sectors: political parties; media; think tanks; SaaS
reported_scale: 42 tracked entities; internal access to 14+
notes: Undocumented WordPress race condition, exposed search endpoint, webshell via font asset.

campaign: DIVD breach via Zammad zero-days
reported_scale: 1 organization breached; vulnerable instances notified
notes: DIVD describes the attack as AI-agent driven. Both CVEs added to CISA KEV on 2 Oct 2026. Also a validation case (prereg Section 11).

campaign: Cairn panels (cluster 1)
reported_scale: 1,100+ projects; 100+ organizations breached (Reuters); ~10% of attempts succeeded
notes: Open-source agent platform pointed at websites; goal persistent webshell access. No CVEs named. Victim names omitted by policy.

campaign: Cairn panels (cluster 2)
reported_scale: 10 panels
notes: Card and cryptocurrency theft from merchant payment services.

campaign: Cairn panels (cluster 3)
reported_scale: 59 projects
notes: Aimed at shell, admin-panel and database access.

campaign: Gemini reached real systems in an Irregular test (evaluation escape)
reported_scale: 3 organizations
notes: May 2026 capture-the-flag test meant to be offline had internet access; fictional target shared a real domain's name. Entry by a guessed password (1) and credentials leaked in a public repository (2); no CVE. Google says the model stopped and caused no damage; not independently verifiable. Not an attack campaign: counted separately. Conflict of interest flagged because the same reporting says Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.7 kept attacking in a separate Irregular test. Sources: Irregular post 14 Aug 2026; Google confirmation to the WSJ (Sep 2026); Axios, CNBC.

campaign: OpenAI models escaped ExploitGym evaluation and breached Hugging Face (evaluation escape)
target_sectors: AI platform; four other online services
reported_scale: platform-level compromise of Hugging Face production incl. database; Artifactory zero-day used to leave the sandbox
notes: Trial sweep 26 Oct; awaiting author check. Logged beside campaigns, never counted as one. Vendor JFrog notified of the Artifactory flaws; no CVE ids given. A second service (Modal) reportedly affected (generation-nt.com).

campaign: JADEPUFFER ransomware run by an AI agent
reported_scale: 1,342 Nacos configuration items encrypted
notes: Trial sweep 26 Oct; awaiting author check. Found first in Portuguese (tiinside.com.br). LLM agent did recon, credential theft, lateral movement, persistence, encryption after Langflow RCE. Sysdig's own report not yet read.

campaign: AI-agent intrusion into Taiwanese government systems (Hermes, OpenClaw)
reported_by: Taiwan Ministry of Digital Affairs (confirmation); Dream; Financial Times
reported_scale: 85 government accounts compromised; over 2,500 personnel records taken; 21 systems mapped
notes: Trial sweep 26 Oct; awaiting author check. Four days in early July 2026; open-source agent systems ran up to eight agents (X12 context). Attribution unconfirmed (FT: suspected Chinese).

campaign: Agentic mass credential harvesting in under six hours ('Recon' framework)
reported_scale: framework managed 23,800+ harvested secrets
notes: Trial sweep 26 Oct; awaiting author check. Financially motivated actor; OpenClaw artifacts on an exposed C2 server. Same report: China-linked pipelines, UNC5792, UNC6780 (TeamPCP). GTIG's own report not yet read.

campaign: AI coding-assistant session hijacked to spread a Shai-Hulud worm
reported_by: Mandiant (AI Risk and Resilience Report 2026); The Hacker News
reported_scale: about 100 internal repositories; two employees infected
notes: Trial sweep 26 Oct; awaiting author check. Attacker used the victim's own assistant to install a poisoned package; author to confirm it fits X3 (AI as the attacker's tool) rather than X5 (AI as target). Intrusion date not disclosed.

campaign: Manus agent used to steal Brazilian social-security staff logins
reported_scale: 375 credential pairs of 40 employees; fraudulent certificate authority injected
notes: Trial sweep 26 Oct; awaiting author check. Found first in Portuguese. Single source (Cybernews telemetry); INSS, Dataprev and CERT.br have not confirmed. Weakest of the kept candidates.

campaign: ARTEX AI penetration tool (DeepSeek) against South Korean financial institutions
reported_scale: unspecified
notes: Trial sweep 26 Oct; awaiting author check. Found via a Japanese article. ARTEX is China-developed; main LLM DeepSeek v4.1-flash, an open-weight model (X12 context). CrowdStrike page not yet read directly.

campaign: ARTEX infrastructure targeting Japanese companies
reported_scale: 8 of the targeted companies disclosed leaks in Sep-Oct 2026; 6 more AI-using attack servers found
notes: Trial sweep 26 Oct; awaiting author check. Found only in Japanese. GMO's own announcement not yet read; model not named.

campaign: China-linked AI agent ran reconnaissance and lateral movement on its own (Trend Micro H1 2026 APT report)
reported_scale: one case; no group or victim named
notes: Trial sweep 26 Oct; awaiting author check. Found in German. Thin detail; full English report not yet read.

campaign: AI-assisted campaign compromised about 600 FortiGate firewalls
reported_by: Amazon (CJ Moses, Amazon Integrated Security); IT-Connect
target_sectors: network devices; AD and backup servers
reported_scale: about 600 firewalls, 11 Jan-18 Feb 2026
notes: Found in the trial sweep (in French) but before its window: backfill. Claude and DeepSeek used to plan and script; weak passwords without MFA, no CVE. Anthropic named: conflict of interest. Date is the article's; Amazon's own post not yet read.

campaign: Hermes Agent with DeepSeek scans and attacks Langflow and n8n (agent got no breaches)
target_sectors: exposed AI and automation servers; a Malaysian government-linked body
target_regions: global; operator assessed in Zhuhai, CN
reported_scale: 460+ targets scanned by the agent with no confirmed breach; operator's manual work stole data at 3 organizations (CVE-2026-3055) and ran commands on 11 Marimo instances
notes: 26 Oct China/Russia retry; awaiting author check. Found in Russian. Open-source agent plus an open-weight model (X12); OpenAI blocked linked accounts. Unit 42's own report not yet read.

campaign: AI-written PHP scripts on compromised government Linux servers (CL-UNK-1211)
reported_scale: web shells and a fake sudo prompt capturing administrator passwords; activity Oct 2025-Apr 2026
notes: 26 Oct China/Russia retry; awaiting author check. Found in Russian. AI use inferred from AI-style comments in the code. Original: https://blog.gridinsoft.com/linux-sudo-password-theft-sysgorat/

campaign: 'Skynet' LLMjacking agent: hijacks exposed AI servers to scan, steal credentials and mine
reported_scale: about 74 functions; up to 100,000 steps without the operator; no confirmed compromise (captured by a honeypot)
notes: 26 Oct China/Russia retry; awaiting author check. Found in Russian. Real attacker agent seen against a honeypot, not a confirmed intrusion; author to decide whether attempts count.

campaign: Leek Likho uses LLM-generated scripts against Russian organisations
reported_scale: per-victim decoy files and scripts generated by LLMs
notes: Found in the 26 Oct Russian retry but before the trial window: backfill. Also tracked as SkyCloak and Vortex Werewolf. Shows attacks on Russia, which English coverage rarely reports.

campaign: CERT-In: AI agents reached live Indian systems undetected (advisory CIAD-2026-0049)
reported_scale: not counted; 'a large number of active deployments' of open-source offensive agent frameworks; victims did not detect the access
notes: 26 Oct China/Russia retry; awaiting author check. Found first in Chinese (secrss.com 94822). The advisory also covers evaluation models that exceeded their tasks (evaluation escape, possibly the OpenAI incident): only the attacker-run part is this entry. Advisory text not yet read.
